description: Schedule tenant erasure after seven days using the exact confirmation phrase. The confirmation phrase must be exactly `delete <organization_id>` — typing the id is the point, so nobody erases the wrong tenant by clicking. Erasure deletes the workspace data in CommsHarbor; the organization itself and what it bought (global entitlements, payment receipts) live in the shared account and stay, as does the audit trail.
name: commsharbor_deletion_schedule
